**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 278 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 --- A glass orb atop this metal staff contains fine sand. While wielding the staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to identify morph and polymorph magic. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list. **Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells. Fluid Form Staff **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 278 **Price** 230 gp ---
  • **1st** [_pest form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1626)
  • **2nd** [_animal form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1440), [_enlarge_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1514), [_shrink_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1672)
Fluid Form Staff (Greater) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 278 **Price** 900 gp ---
  • **3rd** [_feet to fins_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1525), [_insect form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1575)
  • **4th** [_aerial form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1437), animal form, [_dinosaur form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1489)
Fluid Form Staff (Major) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 278 **Price** 4,000 gp ---
  • **5th** animal form, insect form
  • **6th** [_cursed metamorphosis_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1479), [_dragon form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1502), [_plant form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1637)
name: Fluid Form Staff (Major)
